title: Vector Flow Field — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Corridor to system
scenes.purpose: Show an idea (a regular seed region) flowing as a corridor field, then one coupling parameter bends every streamline into a vortex sink whose boundary is highlighted as the connected system.
visuals: Stationary dark teal gradient plane (#0A1C22 to #0F2A30)
Seed region of regular dashes at left with 24 frozen release points
Grid of field-direction hairs oriented by the shared vector function
24 thin subdued streamlines integrated (RK2) on the same field
Single high-contrast #76E1CB boundary ellipse with nodes and core
Monospace parameter readout 'COUPLING k' on an opaque backing
Headline on a quiet backing band below the traces

beats.development: Field direction established: hairs fade in pointing right, streamlines grow from the seed region straight along the corridor with travelling head dots.

One parameter varies: coupling k rises 0 to 1; every hair and streamline is re-integrated from the same frozen seeds and bends together into a converging counter-clockwise vortex. Boundary ellipse draws from the inflow node from 1.6 s.
Boundary complete with nodes and core; its label appears after the ellipse closes; headline settles by 2.4 s and the full composition holds.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system

findings: Field direction is readable before the parameter changes; the parameter change is a single sustained 1.25 s action so all paths respond together.
Composition fully settled by 2.4 s, under the 2.7 s requirement.
justifiedHolds: 0.6 s final hold (2.4–3.0 s) for reading the headline and boundary label.

notes: Silent preview: no music, effects or narration.
Recipe demonstrated: corridor flow transitioning to vortex + divergence (sink) via one coupling parameter; STYLE.json lists no tech.preview_recipes and no BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json was supplied.
